Application fee waivers
Ohio State works with a variety of programs that provide fee waivers to applicants, and also manages several of its own programs. You can check your eligibility by selecting from the waiver programs in the drop-down below.
Note: International students are not eligible for some fee waivers. Read descriptions below.
To use a fee waiver
Check the box in the Application Fee Waiver section of your admissions application (Ohio State's regular or supplemental application) indicating the program for which you qualify.
Complete and submit your admission application. You will not be asked to pay the application fee.
Most waiver programs require additional actions. Select your waiver program from the drop-down below and follow the instructions.
Monitor the status of your fee waiver request in your Applicant Center. If you decide you would like to pay the fee, or if your waiver request is denied, click "Pay Application Fee" in your Applicant Center.

Required actions

Alumni online program applicants
The Ohio State University Alumni Association and the Office of Distance Education have established an application fee waiver for Ohio State alumni who apply to a fully online degree or certificate program.
Eligibility
You must be a graduate of The Ohio State University at the time of application who is applying to one of Ohio State's online degree or certificate programs.
Required actions
Follow the directions at the top of this page. No further action is required.
Big Ten Academic Alliance
The Big Ten Academic Alliance is a consortium of the Big Ten member universities plus the University of Chicago. The FreeApp program is designed to increase access to graduate education for students who bring qualities and experience that will enhance the diversity of graduate students at member universities.
Eligibility
To be eligible to submitÂ a FreeApp waiver request form, you must meet BTAA's criteria. Not open to international applicants.
Required actions
Complete the FreeApp request form. A link to this form can be found at the bottom of the FreeApp program website.
Once your request is received, the Graduate School will contact you to verify your eligibility for this fee waiver. The Graduate School may be contacted at gradrecruit@osu.edu.
Big Ten Academic Alliance Traveling Scholar
Eligibility
To be eligible for the BTAA's Traveling Scholar Program, you must be a doctoral student enrolled in a participating Big Ten Academic Alliance institution or the University of Chicago, and follow the actions below.
Required actions
Verify that the desired opportunity is not available at your home university.
Obtain approval from your advisor, who must confirm that the Traveling Scholar opportunity will significantly enhance your doctoral studies.
Secure support from the host campus, including confirmation from the course instructor and/or a faculty sponsor.
Then, complete the BTAA Traveling Scholar Application (submit no later than the normal registration deadline for the relevant semester or term) and select the BTAA Traveling Scholar application fee waiver on your Ohio State application.
Read more about this program's eligibility and enrollment criteria, or email ts.coordinator@btaa.org.
Current or former Ohio State undergraduate student
Eligibility
Ohio State undergraduate students applying to an undergraduate professional major do not have to pay the application fee.
Required actions
On the "Final Steps/Submit" tab of the application, under the Application Fee Waiver section, click the box that reads, "I am a current or former Ohio State undergraduate student," and follow the instructions.
Economic Disadvantage Fee Waiver
Eligibility
Applicants who have limited financial resources and qualify for federal financial aid may be eligible for an application fee waiver from Ohio State. (International students are not eligible but are encouraged to research EducationUSA Opportunity Funds, which, if awarded, can be used to pay the application fee.)
Required actions
Submit one of the following via email to esue-gpfeewaivers@osu.edu.
A copy of your approved AMCAS, DAT, LSAT, OAT, PCAT or GRE fee waiver (for tests taken within 12 months of the application date.)
A copy of a letter on official letterhead from an agency official verifying that you or your family have qualified for public assistance based on low income criteria for the current 12 month period.
A copy of your financial aid award letter for the current year from another / previous institution or a copy of your federal Student Aid Report (SAR) that verifies you qualified for financial aid within the current 12 month period based on a Student Aid Index (SAI)* of not more than 1,500.
*The SAI must be provided on the document you submit.
GP recruit fee waiver
Eligibility
You are eligible for this fee waiver if an Ohio State representative at a recruitment event provided you with a code to waive the application fee for graduate study.
Required actions
Enter the code in the Fee Waiver section of your admissions application.
Graduate Engineering Open House
Eligibility
If you attended the Graduate Engineering Open House in October, you are eligible for an application fee waiver from Ohio State.
Required actions
Follow the directions at the top of this page. No further action is required.
PGD Program
Eligibility
You are eligible for this fee waiver if your graduate department has offered to pay your application fee. You must obtain this approval from your prospective department prior to submitting your application. You cannot be admitted until the application fee is paid.
Required actions
Have your program send confirmation of your participation to esue-gpfeewaivers@osu.edu.
Previous OSU Graduate Student
Eligibility
Former Ohio State graduate students who finished a degree but would like to take classes can apply for graduate non-degree status and are not required to pay the application fee.
Note: Current or former Ohio State graduate students applying for a degree or certificate program should submit an Intra-University Transfer application. There is no fee for this application.
Required actions
On the "Final Steps/Submit" tab of the non-degree application, under the Application Fee Waiver section, click the box that reads, "Previous OSU Graduate Student." No further action is required. Previous enrollment status will be verified after submission. Waiver must be selected at the time of application.
Summer Research Opportunities Program and Big Ten Academic Alliance
Eligibility
If you have participated in a Summer Research Opportunities Program sponsored by the Big Ten Academic Alliance (formerly CIC), such as Ohio State's SROP program, you are eligible for an application fee waiver from Ohio State. Not open to international applicants.
Required actions
Complete the FreeApp request form. A link to this form can be found at the bottom of the FreeApp program website.
Once your request is received, the Graduate School will contact you to verify your eligibility for this fee waiver. The Graduate School may be contacted at esue-gpfeewaivers@osu.edu.
Fine print: Please read!
An admission decision will not be made on your application until your waiver is approved or the application fee is paid.
All waiver requests will be verified.
Only one fee waiver is permitted per academic year.
The application fee is NONREFUNDABLE. If you pay the application fee, even if in error, we can no longer honor your fee waiver request.
